context_requirements: Expression of carbonic anhydrase isoforms (especially CA9, CA12, CA2) on the target cell
Hypoxic or acidic tumor microenvironment to drive CA9/CA12 dependence
Functional pH regulatory machinery (bicarbonate transporters, proton pumps) that CA inhibition can disrupt
Intact apoptotic signaling for late apoptosis readouts
falsifiers: No change in HIF1A, VEGFA, or CA9 expression at 6 h or 24 h in any cell line
No reduction in proliferation markers (e.g., CCND1, MYC, PCNA) at 24 h
No induction of apoptosis markers (e.g., BAX, PMAIP1, CASP3) at 24 h
Strong transcriptional responses in cell lines lacking CA9/CA12 expression under normoxia

evidence.supports: Acetazolamide reduces intestinal polyp proliferation and induces apoptosis, with decreased IL-6 and NRF2 involvement
CAIX inhibition induces G0/G1 arrest and apoptosis in HeLa cells with altered apoptotic gene expression
CA9 inhibition downregulates HIF-1α and VEGF and upregulates apoptosis-related proteins in breast cancer cells
Dual EGFR/CA inhibitor causes G1 arrest and apoptosis in cancer cells
CAI reduces inflammatory factors and modulates CAXIV/AQP4 in retinal cells

changes: Moved HIF1A from proximal_up to proximal_down: CA inhibition reduces HIF-1α protein and HIF1A transcription, as supported by PMID 37748406.
Moved BNIP3 from proximal_up to proximal_down: BNIP3 is a canonical HIF-1 target and is expected to decrease when HIF1A is downregulated.
Removed VEGFA from the falsifiers because it is not in the landmark gene list and cannot be measured in this experiment.
